headline: The people who teach the practice.
lead: London-based coaches with decades of experience — teaching across the city since 2005.
footnote: LONDON-BASED COACHES — TEACHING ACROSS THE CITY SINCE 2005

source_manual.name: Andy Pearson
source_manual.bio: On London's streets since 2005 — helped develop ParkourUK and has coached weekly as a senior coach for nearly two decades.

source_manual.name: Kie Piccio
source_manual.bio: A former competitive swimmer who coaches adults and brings a creative, playful style to children's classes.

source_manual.name: Leon Lawrence
source_manual.bio: Renowned London coach and certified PT — grounded in strength, confidence and practical movement.

source_manual.name: Mesh Ganeshlaingam
source_manual.bio: Blends a dance background into his parkour for a unique flow, with a holistic mind-body focus.
